note: All eight transcripts opened from the AEL IR site (Investor Downloads > Earnings Call Files). The shell could not download the PDFs (proxy 403); text was read via WebFetch, which caps verbatim extraction at ~125 characters, so long quotes are joined fragments marked '...'. Quotes are verbatim as extracted but not byte-checked against the raw PDF. Outcomes rest on AEL results presentations/press releases and later call transcripts unless tagged [media]. FY26 consolidated capex is not disclosed in any deck; the outcome used is the Q4 FY26 call statement that capex was 'close to just about 95%' of target (~Rs 34,200 cr on the Rs 36,000 cr target, derived). No call in the window contains an assurance on the US DOJ/SEC indictment or the OFAC matter (OFAC settlement USD 275 mn announced 18 May 2026; Rs 2,644 cr exceptional in Q1 FY27), so no class-10 override was triggered. Class-9 items are graded at the call where the refusal occurred. Rule 6: the file holds no Reg. 30 statutory 'no material impact' line, so nothing was removed and no amount/PAT test was needed. Rule 7: older calls opened (28 Oct 2021, 4 May 2022, Q1 FY24, Q2 FY24, Q3 FY24, Q4 FY24, Q1 FY25), searched for material topics only. Items without a rule-7 note had no earlier statement found there; minor items were not traced exhaustively. Q4 FY23 and Q1 FY23 transcripts were not found on the IR site. v1.2 rule-7 re-grade: 20 promises traced to their earliest statement, 10 of them to calls before the window. Five outside_window entries added (Q1 FY25, Q4 FY24, Q3 FY24, Q4 FY22, Q2 FY22). 39 in-window restatements were folded into the origin notes. Navi Mumbai is now graded on 'by 2024' (Oct 2021) = 0, FY25 capex on Rs 92,000 cr = 0, ANIL 10 GW on FY26 = 0, copper peak capacity on FY26 = 0 and PVC on FY26 cash flows = 1 (reasoned cut). Removed duplicates included grades of 2 (Navi Mumbai Q3 FY26 opening, copper segment, copper EBITDA Q1 FY27, MDO FY25/FY26). Score_10 was missing (implied 4.3 on 8 entries) and is now 3.5 on 13 entries.
